candidate_relations.reason: The candidate describes nonspecific biopsy findings under a muscular dystrophy label but omits the SCN4A etiology and incorrectly classifies the disorder as dystrophy rather than SCN4A-associated congenital myopathy.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Congenital muscular dystrophy is incompatible with the specified SCN4A-associated congenital myopathy caused by compound heterozygous variants.
